title: Set self.rng inside LangevinBAOAB when not supplied.
body:
This shows up as this error

```
line 435, in _BAOAB_OU
    * (self.rng.normal(size=vel_shape).T / np.sqrt(masses)).T
       ^^^^^^^^
AttributeError: 'LangevinBAOAB' object has no attribute 'rng'
```

when one actually runs the dynamics after setting it up without explicitly supplying an RNG. It comes from a tiny typo that sets rng instead of self.rng. This MR fixes that.

comments.author: ajjackson
comments.body:
Argh, good find! This logic went through quite a few review iterations, not surprising that something like that would happen.

It would be better to test this code path somehow, but for obvious reasons the tests use fixed random seeds.

We could have a very short test that initializes the MD object and checks the warning was raised?

(I'd like to factor out this logic and make it more universal across the stochastic MD routines at some point...)

comments.author: ajjackson
comments.body:
@Chronum94 can you add a unit test such as

```python
def test_LangevinBAOAB_default_rng(atoms, calc):
    """Test LangevinBAOAB can be initialised with rng=None"""
    atoms.calc = calc

    with pytest.warns(UserWarning, match="No rng provided, generated one with seed"):
        dyn = LangevinBAOAB(
            atoms,
            timestep=timestep,
            temperature_K=300,
            T_tau=50 * timestep,
            rng=None)

    dyn.run(n_steps)

```

which reproduces the error with no fix and passes with the fix.

comments.author: askhl
comments.body:
I still think we should make the rng keyword identical to other rng keywords, i.e.,

```
def myfunc(rng=np.random):
    ...
```

Maybe we'll want something other than that, but if we do, then we *always* want something other than that, and then that's a separate issue.

comments.author: ajjackson
comments.body:
Better to fix the bug here and then look at consistent behaviour later, I think.

I tried applying something like the approach you suggested here in another project: https://github.com/pace-neutrons/Euphonic/pull/437 There is a quasi-global `rng` instance used as the default value, so the type is always some kind of Generator. Seems nice, although it lacks the "here is your seed" feature of LangevinBAOAB. As we discussed in maintainer meeting that sort of information should probably exist at a different logging level and we need to make wider decisions about logging anyway.

comments.author: ajjackson
comments.body: @Chronum94 would you be able to add that test, or should one of us take over the branch? Would streamline review process a bit if you do it ;-)
